true_answer: I am asleep if I dream. 2. I dream only if I am asleep. 3. In order to dream, I must be asleep. 4. To dream, it is necessary that I am asleep. 5. To be asleep, it is sufficient to dream. 6. I am not dreaming unless I am asleep. The following are equivalent to the converse (if I am asleep, then I dream): 1. I dream if I am asleep. 2. I am asleep only if I dream. 3. It is necessary that I dream in order to be asleep. 4. It is sufficient that I be asleep in order to dream. 5. If I don’t dream, then I’m not asleep. Hopefully you agree with the above example.
